from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class FinancialDisclosure(BaseModel):
    """Financial data extracted from one document."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="The company this report belongs to, as named in the document")
    stock_code: str | None = Field(description="Stock code if present in the document")
    special_reserve_amount: float | None = Field(description="Special reserve amount reported for this company; None if not present or empty")
    special_reserve_currency: str | None = Field(description="Currency unit of the amount, e.g., '元'")
    reporting_period: str | None = Field(description="Reporting period mentioned in the document")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    financial_disclosures: list[FinancialDisclosure]
